expectedBehavior: An explicit Play action produces the selected local reference tone through the current Watch audio route and the UI reports actual playback state.
notes: User reports that Watch output now plays. Startup clicking is tracked separately by active I-0004; this issue remains awaiting explicit user verification/closure.
observedBehavior: On a physical Apple Watch, tapping Play changes the UI to Playback requested but produces no audible tone through the Watch speaker.
reproductionSteps: Install the latest Xcode Watch build, select a pitch, set output to 25%, and tap Play while using the built-in Watch speaker.

workItem.title: Watch Play does not produce audible local tone
